segments.thig2.6:2.3: Nisinnā camhi selamhi, atha cittaṃ vimucci me;
segments.thig2.6:2.5: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.

lines: Atha cittaṃ vimucci meti selamhi pāsāṇe nisinnā camhi, atha tadanantaraṃ vīriyasamatāya sammadeva yojitattā maggapaṭipāṭiyā sabbehipi āsavehi mama cittaṃ vimucci.
